expertise.title: Databases
expertise.description: Schema design, query optimization and warehousing on Oracle, PostgreSQL and SQL Server. Led a full financial-system migration end to end.

expertise.title: Cybersecurity
expertise.description: Network security, risk assessment, security auditing and log analysis. CompTIA Security+ and a Seneca postgraduate certificate.

description: Led the architecture of a secure investment data platform using Java, Spring Boot, React, and REST APIs, improving data discovery and reducing portfolio processing time by 65%.
Introduced event-driven microservices, automated testing, CI/CD, and observability to address scalability risks, increasing deployment reliability and reducing production incidents by 53%
Built Docker-based CI/CD pipelines with automated integration tests and production monitoring, shortening release cycles by 33% and improving service resilience.
Migrated financial processing services with Java, Spring Boot, and Oracle SQL, automating validation workflows and reducing manual reconciliation effort by 40%.
Implemented role-based access controls, audit logging, data-quality checks, and lineage tracking to meet governance requirements and improve traceability across regulated datasets.
Directed design reviews and mentored engineers on domain-driven design, API security, and performance optimization, accelerating delivery by 25% while strengthening engineering standards.
Developed responsive mobile and web experiences with TypeScript, React, and reusable components, enabling field teams to securely capture operational data and improving completion rates by 25%.
Integrated mobile applications with versioned REST APIs and event-driven services, adding resilient synchronization that maintained reliable operations in low-connectivity environments.
Partnered with product, security, and field stakeholders to translate operational requirements into scalable solutions, improving application performance and reducing user-reported issues by 20%.
